actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: In the last round several residents gave >30 units, so I punish one (Resident4) with the maximum severity my wallet allows, and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide: check recent round contributions >30? In round 2, contributions: Resident4 112.4, Resident5 60.5, Resident6 60.5. Several >30. Rule: "If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost))." We can punish only one? It says punish that resident - ambiguous. Probably pick one? Could punish each? But choose at most one physical action. So pick one target, max severity. Our wallet 58.35, punishment_cost 0.3, max severity = floor(58.35/0.3)= floor(194.5)=194. So we can punish with severity 194, costing 194*0.3=58.2, within wallet. Choose a resident who contributed >30, e.g., Resident4 (112.4). We'll punish Resident4 severity 194. Then broadcast message discouraging large contributions. That's allowed both physical and communication. So actions list two items.
